daily.title: Frances Crawford's sister says she was 'scared' to leave husband
daily.summary: One of her sister's told the jury she and Ms Crawford were close and spoke regularly, and she was aware the couple's "marriage was in disrepair".

daily.title: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases in DRC after nurse killed, another injured
daily.summary: The outbreak is now the second largest Ebola virus outbreak globally, and the fastest growing in the DRC's history according to health officials.

daily.title: Mushroom killer Erin Patterson's appeal decision set for Friday
daily.summary: If the appeal succeeds, Victoria's Court of Appeal could order a re-trial or acquit Erin Patterson entirely.

daily.title: US Democrats forced to face left-wing momentum as midterms loom
daily.summary: Democrats have long debated whether progressive candidates are "electable". There could soon be a solid answer.

daily.title: Triple-fatal plane crash 'likely' followed instructor's mid-air rule breach
daily.summary: A flight instructor killed along with two young pilots in a plane crash near the Murray Mouth had "likely" entered a spin for which the aircraft had not been approved, the ATSB finds.

daily.title: Man accused of injuring police officer during e-bike crackdown faces court
daily.summary: Court documents allege the incident earlier this month resulted in the officer being seriously injured and requiring surgery to reattach his kneecap to a tendon.

daily.title: Riverfire fireworks delayed after CFMEU members let on to construction site
daily.summary: Fireworks for the 2023 Riverfire festival in Brisbane were delayed after CFMEU members were walking out on an under-construction bridge and into the fireworks exclusion zone.

daily.title: Fox axing from Devils VFL not due to single incident, club says

daily.title: Netanyahu and opposition on equal footing in Israeli election with no clear winner
daily.summary: Early exit polling and results show incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc in a near neck-and-neck race with the opposition, with neither group securing enough seats to form government.

daily.title: Chair of childcare operator quits after abuse scandal
daily.summary: Ugari Nona announced her resignation from NPA Family and Community Services on Facebook as the ABC began promoting a Four Corners investigation into a childcare centre in Far North Queensland.

daily.title: Treasurer not ready to 'put up white flag' on troubled hospital's $3.2b budget
daily.summary: After more than a year of speculation about a major cost blowout, the state government is set to receive a final price on the new Women's and Children's Hospital within months.

daily.title: 13yo alleged extremist a victim of 'big tech', court hears

daily.title: Castaway cows found on tropical island months after flood
daily.summary: Authorities are trying to track down the owners of two cows found living on a tropical island in a Far North Queensland national park several months after a major flood may have swept them from the mainland.

daily.title: Court jails disqualified driver high on meth over fatal crash
daily.summary: A WA man who was on bail and disqualified from driving when he caused the fatal crash on Albany Highway has been jailed for 10 years.

daily.title: Australia providing 'extraordinary' support to ICC staff amid Trump sanctions

daily.summary: The former childcare worker is currently serving life in jail in Queensland after admitting to offences against 69 girls at early learning centres in Brisbane and Italy over two decades.

daily.title: Lamarre-Condon told ex-colleague 'goodbye' before handing self in, jury told
daily.summary: A former colleague of Beau Lamarre-Condon, known by the pseudonym Fiona Rosso, tell a jury the accused stopped at her home unexpectedly days after the deaths of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

daily.title: Jones accuser admits lying to police over assault by different person

daily.summary: Failed presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro has fled Brazil for the United States, which has confirmed it will grant him and his family entry visas.

daily.title: Rockliff voices support for ban on conversion practices as debate starts

daily.title: Two ironies emerge out of Israel's deadlocked election
daily.summary: With no clear winner, it will be up to Israeli President Isaac Herzog to decide whether any of the parties can form what he regards as a workable coalition.

daily.title: ABC tells One Nation to remove cartoon with violent depiction of Bluey
daily.summary: In an episode of Pauline Hanson's Please Explain series released in 2024, Bluey and former Victorian premier Daniel Andrews were depicted running over each other.

daily.title: How Libby Trickett is talking to her kids about the ultra-thinness trend
daily.summary: The rise of ultra-thinness is putting children at risk of body dissatisfaction, low self-esteem and eating disorders, and parents need to address what their kids are seeing, experts warn.
